results.question: Is 'Read more' acceptable link text?
results.answer_preview:
No. Source [1] says link text must describe the destination. It says "Click here" and "Read more" on their own are not allowed. [1]

results.question: What's our minimum color contrast for body text?
results.answer_preview: Your conventions set the minimum color contrast for body text at 4.5:1 [1].
